Corollary
[scalar curvature monotonicity for ancient solutions] Source: cao-zhu 1. Corollary 2.5.8\group Cao–Zhu Li-Yau-Hamilton Estimates Let $g_{ij}(x,t)$ be a complete ancient solution of the Ricci flow on $M\times (-\infty , T)$ with bounded and nonnegative curvature operator, then the scalar curvature $R(x,t)$ is pointwise nondecreasing in time $t$.
